#EmbeddedSystemsConsultant  
Fiona MacLeod is an embedded systems consultant at NexaTech Solutions, bridging hardware and software to solve real-world challenges. With a focus on firmware development, she collaborates with teams to create reliable, scalable solutions for IoT devices.  

Skills: IoT protocols (MQTT/CoAP), RTOS integration, sensor data pipelines, and REST API frameworks. Comfortable troubleshooting network latency issues and automating workflows with Python.  

Currently, Fiona is optimizing firmware for low-power sensors in smart agriculture projects, ensuring seamless communication across edge devices. She’s also working on a custom RTOS for industrial automation, prioritizing real-time performance without sacrificing flexibility.  

When not coding, Fiona enjoys hiking and experimenting with open-source hardware. She’s always looking for ways to simplify complex systems—because good engineering isn’t about complexity, it’s about clarity.  

Let’s connect if you’re building the future, one line of code at a time.
